title: Local PHP reads clear public custom ports while EmDash and remote sites retain their target ports
expect: All 89 reader/native workflow tests pass. A local WordPress or Joomla site publicly served on 8443 is read through HTTP port 80, preserving path and query.
Local EmDash retains container port 4321. Remote custom public port 8443 and external font origins remain unchanged.
A refused content door retains COMPONENT_NOT_REGISTERED before any subsequent record read or mutation.
fence: Resolve protocol, hostname and port from the same target origin.
